items.evidence: Log lines 30-139 show 19 µL mix, 2.5 µL fwd and rev primers A1-G1/A2-G2 to A1-G1, and 1 µL templates from A1,A1,B1,C1,A1,A1,D1 to the right wells.
Log 198-336 show 19 µL water, 5 µL rCutSmart, 1 µL DpnI and 3-cycle mixes in A1-G1; the code records the 37/65°C incubation and Zymo cleanup with protocol.comment.
Log 338-488 show 7 µL water, 2 µL T4 buffer, 3/2/3 µL of fragments 2/5/6, 2 µL of fragments 1/3/4/7 and 1 µL enzyme with 5x mix into A1-D1.
The Golden Gate program (37/16°C x30, 60°C), assembly cleanup, ice/heat shock and recovery are recorded as comments; log shows 5 µL to cells A1-D1 then 250 µL LB.
The move() helper picks up and drops a fresh tip for every aspirate/dispense pair, and the log shows no tip reuse across wells or fragments.

judge.summary: The protocol matches the specified volumes, well pairings and order in the simulator log. Non-simulated steps are recorded as comments, and a fresh tip is used for every transfer.
